title: mentiondrop
description: AI-triaged brand, competitor and demand mentions from Reddit, Google News and search.
summary: AI-triaged brand, competitor and demand mentions from Reddit, Google News and search.
offersHint: AI-triaged brand, competitor and demand mentions from Reddit, Google News and search. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.mentiondrop.com/api/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Account-scoped MentionDrop API key created in Settings, sent as: Bearer md_live_...

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Account-scoped MentionDrop API key created in Settings, sent as: Bearer md_live_...

toolsPreview.name: list_keywords
toolsPreview.description: List every keyword this MentionDrop account monitors, with its id, role (own_brand, competitor, or industry), and active state. Call this first to discover the keyword ids and role names the other tools accept.

toolsPreview.name: create_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Start monitoring a new keyword for this account. Takes an optional role (own_brand, competitor, or industry) and a short context string that sharpens relevance scoring. Enforces the account plan keyword limit and rejects keywords too generic to produce signal.

toolsPreview.name: update_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Update one existing monitored keyword by id: change its role, context, active state, minimum relevance threshold, excluded content types, or exclusion terms. Use list_keywords to find the id. Pausing a keyword sets is_active to false rather than deleting it.

toolsPreview.name: get_recent_mentions
toolsPreview.description: Return the most recent mentions matched for this account, newest first, each with its AI summary, sentiment, relevance score, and suggested action. Filter by keyword role, specific keyword, source, sentiment, and date range. Use this to answer "what came in lately".

toolsPreview.name: search_mentions
toolsPreview.description: Find mentions whose title, summary, URL, suggested action, or matched keyword contain every word in the query. Use this to look for a specific topic, product, or phrase rather than a plain time window.

toolsPreview.name: get_competitor_signals
toolsPreview.description: Return recent mentions matched by competitor-role keywords, optionally narrowed to a single competitor name. Use this to see what people are publicly saying about rival products.

toolsPreview.name: get_pain_signals
toolsPreview.description: Return recent industry-role mentions that read as demand or pain signals, meaning they carry a suggested action or score at least 80 for relevance. Use this to find people publicly describing a problem the product solves.

toolsPreview.name: get_digest
toolsPreview.description: Return one grouped catch-up brief of recent mentions, split into owned brand mentions, competitor signals, demand signals, and conversations worth replying to. Use this when a single summary is wanted instead of separate queries.

toolsPreview.name: get_mention
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one mention by id with its full record: title, AI summary, sentiment, relevance score, suggested action, source, and matched keyword. Only returns mentions owned by this account.

toolsPreview.name: mark_mention_reviewed
toolsPreview.description: Record a review verdict on one mention as relevant or not_relevant. This feedback tunes how future mentions are scored for the account. Re-sending the same verdict is safe.

toolsPreview.name: generate_reply_draft
toolsPreview.description: Generate a draft reply or outreach email for one processed mention. Returns draft text for a human to review and never posts, sends, or publishes anything.
